_comment: Copy to config.json. 'defaults' applies to any vault not listed under 'vaults'. Each vault key must be the vault's address in lowercase. This file is how you run your own bots before the web backend (CONFIG_API) exists. Field names still say 'Pls' (kept identical to the PulseChain keeper's config shape on purpose - the site's config API expects the same shape either way), but amounts are in whole ETH here, not PLS; percentages are plain numbers (20 = 20%).
